about: Encoded spark codebook. The parser reads every turn word by word; each rule below is applied prompt-by-prompt and response-by-response. A candidate spark is emitted for a participant turn when the summed weight of the rules of one type reaches settings.min_score. Edit patterns/weights here; no code changes needed. Patterns are case-insensitive Python regular expressions.

signals.connector: \b(?:because|since|so that|what matters|the (?:point|reason|thing) is|i care|i'?d rather|instead|i think|i believe|for me|otherwise|which means|that'?s why)\b
signals.deference: ^\W*(?:ok(?:ay)?|sure|yes|yep|yeah|sounds good|great|perfect|fine|go (?:ahead|for it)|do (?:it|that)|you'?re right|fair enough|makes sense|agreed|i agree)\b

rules.description: Participant says something was new / not previously considered
rules.pattern: \b(?:hadn'?t|haven'?t|had not|never) (?:really )?(?:considered|thought (?:of|about)|reali[sz]ed|known|heard of|seen)\b|\bdidn'?t (?:know|reali[sz]e|think (?:of|about)|consider)\b|\bnew to me\b|\bi forgot (?:about|that)\b|\bgood point\b|\bi wasn'?t aware\b|\bnever occurred to me\b

rules.description: Participant adopts term(s) the agent introduced first (word-level novelty tracking)
Participant re-describes what the problem is really about
rules.pattern: \bthe (?:real|actual|underlying|bigger|core) (?:question|issue|problem|point|goal)\b|\b(?:it'?s|this is|that'?s) (?:really|actually|more|less) (?:about|a question of|a matter of)\b|\breframe\b|\b(?:another|different|new) (?:way|lens|angle) (?:to|of) (?:look|see|think|frame)|\bthink of (?:it|this) as\b|\bwhat (?:i|we) (?:actually|really) (?:need|want|care about)\b|\bso it'?s (?:really|actually|not just)\b|\bdifferent way to look at\b

rules.description: Participant changes the goal / plan of the task
rules.pattern: \b(?:let'?s|we should|i want to|maybe we should|i'?d like to) (?:restructure|rethink|reframe|change (?:the|our) (?:approach|goal|plan)|pivot|step back|start over)\b|\bthe goal (?:should|now) (?:be|is)\b|\binstead of (?:just )?\w+ing\b|\brather than (?:just )?\w+ing\b|\bmaybe the (?:goal|question|task) (?:should be|is)\b

rules.description: Participant voices an insight arising from their own articulation
rules.pattern: (?:\bi (?:just )?reali[sz]e|\bnow that i (?:say|think about|write|put|see)|\bthinking about it (?:more|again)|\bas i (?:explain|say|write|think about)|\bi guess what i (?:really|actually)|\bwhat i (?:really|actually) (?:mean|think|care about|want)|\bcome to think of it|\bon reflection|\bactually,? i (?:think|believe|guess|want)|\bi think the reason (?:i|is))\b

rules.description: ...and the agent had just asked them a question (prompted articulation)
rules.pattern: (?:\bi (?:just )?reali[sz]e|\bnow that i (?:say|think about|write|put|see)|\bthinking about it (?:more|again)|\bas i (?:explain|say|write|think about)|\bi guess what i (?:really|actually)|\bwhat i (?:really|actually) (?:mean|think|care about|want)|\bcome to think of it|\bon reflection|\bactually,? i (?:think|believe|guess|want)|\bi think the reason (?:i|is))\b

rules.description: Participant rejects the agent's proposal AND states their own reasoning
rules.pattern: \b(?:i (?:don'?t|do not) (?:agree|think so|buy (?:that|it)|see it that way|want that)|i disagree|that'?s not (?:right|true|it|what i)|no,? (?:i|that|because|but)|i'?d push back|i'?m not (?:sure|convinced) (?:that|about)|that doesn'?t (?:work|fit|seem right) for me|i (?:wouldn'?t|won'?t) (?:do|want) that)\b

rules.description: Bare disagreement without stated reasoning (pushback only; below threshold alone)
Agent posed a hypothetical and the participant reasons within it
rules.pattern: \b(?:then i(?:'d| would)?|i(?:'d| would) (?:say|want|still|probably|change|then)|in that case|that would (?:change|mean)|if that'?s (?:true|the case)|it depends|i guess (?:then|it))\b

rules.description: Participant poses their own hypothetical variation
Participant links the topic to something they already know or experienced
rules.pattern: \breminds? me (?:of|that|how)\b|\b(?:this|that|it)(?:'s| is) (?:just )?(?:like|similar to|kind of like)\b|\bsimilar to (?:when|how|what)\b|\bsame (?:as|thing as) when\b|\bkind of like\b|\banalog(?:ous|y)\b|\bin my experience\b|\bwhen i (?:was|worked|played|used to)\b|\bthat connects (?:to|with)\b|\bjust like (?:when|how)\b

rules.description: After an agent error/failed output, participant acknowledges the mistake AND pivots to something useful
rules.pattern: \b(?:but|though|however|interesting|useful|instead|didn'?t know|turns out|that gives me|let'?s use|we could use)\b

rules.description: Participant adopts a term that first appeared in (or right after) a failed agent output
